document.title: CVIT expert consensus document on primary percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI) for acute myocardial infarction (AMI) update 2022

recommendations.text: Primary PCI is recommended as the standard reperfusion strategy for patients with ST-segment elevation myocardial infarction.
recommendations.population: Patients with ST-segment elevation myocardial infarction
recommendations.cautions: This procedural consensus is written for Japanese practice; confirm current local systems, devices, drug doses, and jurisdiction-specific guidance.

recommendations.text: Prefer radial arterial access and drug-eluting stents over bare-metal stents when performing primary PCI for STEMI.
recommendations.population: Patients with STEMI undergoing primary PCI
recommendations.cautions: This procedural consensus is written for Japanese practice; confirm current local systems, devices, drug doses, and jurisdiction-specific guidance.

recommendations.text: For STEMI with multivessel coronary disease, consider complete revascularization before hospital discharge, either during the index procedure or as a staged procedure.
recommendations.population: Patients with STEMI and multivessel coronary disease
recommendations.cautions: The document separately discusses cardiogenic shock and jurisdiction-specific practice; apply current local guidance and individual clinical assessment.
